description: Create a project. Issues get identifiers like KEY-1. key is derived from the name if omitted. Give it an `icon`: ONE emoji that fits what the project is about (🛒 online shop, 📱 mobile app, 🌐 website, 🤖 bot, 📣 marketing, 🎨 design, 🎬 video, 🎓 course, 🧾 invoicing/finance, 🏗️ construction...), unless the person asked for none; without one Mewboard guesses from the name.

client.description: the client the project is for: a client name or id (see list_clients / create_client)

icon.description: one emoji that fits the project, shown instead of the first letter of its key, e.g. 🛒 for an online shop

parent.description: make it a sub-project of this project (key or id); at most 3 levels deep

status.description: planned, active (default), paused, completed or canceled

template.description: id of an own project template of the workspace (see list_templates): the project starts with its statuses, fields, milestones, issues and checklists

name: create_project
